root_causes.description: The checkout container was killed and restarted during the incident window (Killing event: 'Container checkout definition changed, will be restarted', followed by Created/Started count=2). The pod additionally entered ImagePullBackOff on the pause image, leaving checkout effectively unavailable ¡ª its server request rate collapsed to ~0 and the memory working set dropped to a fresh-container baseline after the restart.

evidence.query_or_id: Killing: Container checkout definition changed, will be restarted (count=1)
evidence.observed_value: Container kill event for checkout pod during window; container Created (count=2) and Started (count=2) indicating restart
evidence.expected_baseline: No Killing/restart events for checkout pod during steady-state operation

evidence.query_or_id: Back-off pulling image "gcr.io/google-containers/pause:latest" (count=4); Failed: Error: ImagePullBackOff (count=4)
evidence.observed_value: ImagePullBackOff on pause image with ErrImagePull (count=3) and DeadlineExceeded pull failures
evidence.expected_baseline: Images already present / pullable; no BackOff events

evidence.observed_value: request_rate mean=0.018 req/s, p50=0.000, max=0.057 ¡ª checkout serving essentially no traffic
evidence.expected_baseline: request_rate sustained at multiple req/s under normal load-generator traffic

evidence.observed_value: anomaly window [1789544081.978¡ú1789544141.978], max=25333760 bytes then p50 drops to 548864 bytes ¡ª consistent with container restart resetting working set
evidence.expected_baseline: Stable memory working set without abrupt drop to fresh-container baseline

root_causes.description: Frontend error rate was elevated (mean 0.063, max 0.171) because frontend depends on checkout (per topology: frontend ¡ú checkout), and checkout was unavailable due to the pod crash. This is downstream impact, not the originating fault.

evidence.observed_value: error_rate mean=0.063, p95=0.145, max=0.171 during window

remediation_steps: Investigate why the checkout container was killed ('definition changed, will be restarted') ¡ª audit recent Deployment/ConfigMap changes and roll back any breaking change to the checkout deployment
Fix the pause image pull failure: pre-pull gcr.io/google-containers/pause:latest on nodes or correct the image reference/registry access to clear the ImagePullBackOff blocking pod recovery
Verify the checkout pod is Running and Ready after restart, and confirm request_rate returns to baseline via the checkout calls_total metric
Add readiness/liveness probes and appropriate resource requests/limits to the checkout deployment so crashes are detected and recovered quickly
Monitor frontend error_rate until it falls back below 0.01, confirming the dependency failure has resolved
